# Jamb Crash AI

> Nigeria's AI-powered JAMB & UTME preparation platform. Master JAMB with past questions from 2000-2024, personalized AI study plans, score prediction, and daily WhatsApp reminders.

## What this site is

Jamb Crash AI helps Nigerian secondary school students prepare for the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB/UTME) exam. The platform provides:

- Complete JAMB past questions from 2000-2024 across all 14 subjects (English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Literature, Government, Economics, CRS, IRS, Geography, Accounting, Commerce, Agricultural Science)
- AI-powered score prediction and personalized study plans
- Flashcards, study notes, and topic mastery tracking
- JAMB Literature-in-English novels with chapter summaries and likely questions
- Real-time leaderboard and quiz games (Speed Round, Streak Challenge)
- Offline mode for studying without internet
- Daily WhatsApp study reminders
- Scholarships and JAMB news updates

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jambcrash.ai/): App overview, features, and pricing
- [Does JAMB repeat past questions?](https://jambcrash.ai/jamb-repeats-past-questions): Guide explaining how JAMB reuses past questions and how to study them
- [Repeated JAMB Questions](https://jambcrash.ai/repeated-questions): High-yield questions that appear frequently in JAMB
- [Privacy Policy](https://jambcrash.ai/privacy): How user data is collected and used

## Key facts

- JAMB is Nigeria's university entrance examination (UTME)
- JAMB scores range from 0 to 400 across four subjects
- JAMB has repeated questions from past years, especially from 2000-2020 exams
- The platform is optimized for mobile use in Nigeria
